intent: The area between y = x + 2 and y = x^2 is the integral of their difference from x = -1 to x = 2, which is 9/2

must_show.text: x and y axes with ticks and numbers
the parabola y = x^2 and the line y = x + 2, each labelled with its formula
the two points where they cross, (-1, 1) and (2, 4), marked
the area between them, from x = -1 to x = 2, shaded
the integral and its value 9/2, beside the drawing

must: the shaded area ends exactly at the crossings
should: the title is the only text in bold

composition_notes: The axes fill the left two thirds of the frame, the area in their middle. The integral and its value sit on the right.
